test_title: PYST 08: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word.

She has a **__magnificient__** personality.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'magnificient'.**

 
• **The correct spelling would be 'magnificent'.**
 
• The word '**magnificent**' is an **adjective** which means 'impressively beautiful, elaborate, or extravagant'
